n = int(input())
B = [0] * 21
A = [0] * 21

for i in range(1, 17):
    B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1
A[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10

temp = n
digits = 0
while temp:
    digits += 1
    temp //= 10

ans = float('inf')

def explore(pos, current, cost):
    global ans
    if cost >= ans:
        return
    if pos == 0:
        if current == 0:
            ans = cost
        return
    t = current // A[pos]
    delta_neg = abs(t) - 1
    if t < 0:
        delta_neg = -delta_neg
    delta_pos = abs(t) + 1
    if t < 0:
        delta_pos = -delta_pos

    explore(pos - 1, current - t * B[pos], cost + abs(t) * pos)
    explore(pos - 1, current - delta_neg * B[pos], cost + abs(delta_neg) * pos)
    explore(pos - 1, current - delta_pos * B[pos], cost + abs(delta_pos) * pos)

explore(digits, n, 0)
explore(digits, B[digits + 1] - n, digits + 1)
print(ans)
